answer: Physical Presence Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically solve a hardware challenge tied to a unique, tamper-evident sensor reading—such as a measured timber moisture curve—generated by a device sealed in a faraday haven that only passes inspection when opened. The operator cannot forge these readings for many identities because each unit physically costs one device plus inspection labor, and cloning trips the seal. An attacker therefore pays full hardware and manual handling cost per identity, not a marginal software fee.
